notes: One weighted roll per salvaged wreck, so the art runs from flotsam (lantern, crate, cask, driftwood) through a captain's cabin (chest, chart and sextant) to hull pieces (anchor, cannon, strongbox) and one showpiece, the Lighthouse Lamp Room, which the catalog already tags shipwreck. The longboat section (CR-NAU-042) is the most wreck-like piece of all but is grade C, so it is left out; swap it in for the cannon if the owner would rather have it.

entries.why: Weathered ship's lantern, salt-streaked and long out.
Cargo crate hauled from the shallows, hung with seaweed.
Cask burst open by the surf.
Sun-bleached driftwood stranded by the tide.
Anchor crusted green with verdigris and barnacles.
Salvage heap of crate, cask, planks and rope.
Captain's chart with a brass sextant laid across it.
Black iron chest dragged from the seabed.
Bronze-banded ship's cannon on its carriage.
Lighthouse Lamp Room, the great lamp of a lost harbour.
